_comment_stats: installSummary returned HTTP 400 for every one of the 801 apps in this tenant - that per-app endpoint is not usable here, and it costs one wasted call per app. Left OFF. Device/user install counts would need the reports API (deviceManagement/reports/getDeviceInstallStatusReport) instead.
_comment_incremental: Incremental sync always re-reads the app list and assignments (cheap, one call) and only re-reads per-app extras for apps whose lastModifiedDateTime moved. Assignment-only edits do NOT bump that date, which is why assignments are never skipped.
_comment_patterns: TestPatterns / UpdPatterns are matched against the FIRST or LAST token of the name only (separators _ - . are treated as spaces), so 'Attestation Client' is never a test app. Regex, case-insensitive.
_comment_notes: The Notes field is JSON written by the team's tooling: { notes, managed, status, rollout, pilot, lifecycle }. 797 of 801 apps use it, so lifecycle is READ DIRECTLY from the lifecycle key - no guessing. Observed values: LIVE 525, SAT 158, RETIRED 78, UAT 24, FailedUAT 11, PreRollout 1.
_comment_creation: The inner 'notes' string says how the package was created. Blank = made by hand. First match wins.
_comment_lifecycle: Fallback ONLY for the few apps whose Notes are free text rather than JSON. First rule that matches wins.
